topFaqs.question: Why does token cost spike suddenly after 15+ turns?
topFaqs.questionZh: 为什么多轮对话超过 15 轮后单次账单突然飙升？
topFaqs.answer: Large bash outputs (test logs, npm build dumps) bloat the uncached tail and can break cache prefixes if context exceeds limits. Run `/compact` proactively after finishing each subtask or keep `CLAUDE.md` concise.
topFaqs.answerZh: 冗长的终端输出（如完整测试日志或编译报错）会迅速撑大上下文并触发前缀失效。建议每完成一个小任务主动执行 `/compact`，并精简 `CLAUDE.md`。

topFaqs.question: How do I avoid wasting Opus 5.5 tokens on simple grep/file reads?
topFaqs.questionZh: 如何避免简单搜索与读文件也消耗昂贵的旗舰模型额度？
topFaqs.answer: Always set `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL=claude-haiku-5.5` so Claude Code routes subagent file searches and summaries to the $0.10/1M tier.
topFaqs.answerZh: 务必配置 `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL=claude-haiku-5.5`，将文件检索与摘要子任务自动分流至 $0.10/1M 的轻量模型。

topFaqs.question: Why does OpenRouter or DeepSeek fail with 404 or timeout?
topFaqs.questionZh: 通过 OpenRouter 或 DeepSeek 网关接入时为何出现 404 或超时？
topFaqs.answer: Claude Code speaks the `/v1/messages` Anthropic schema, not OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions`. Point `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to an Anthropic-compatible endpoint and raise `API_TIMEOUT_MS=600000`.
topFaqs.answerZh: Claude Code 使用 Anthropic `/v1/messages` 协议而非 OpenAI 格式。必须使用支持 Anthropic 协议的 Base URL，并设置 `API_TIMEOUT_MS=600000` 防止长工具调用超时。
